title: HUK Men (L) Standard Icon Crew
writeup: HUK's Icon Performance Crew long-sleeve shirt in Seagull, men's size L (MPN H1200573-059-L), is new on Woot for $15.99. It's a UPF 50+ fishing shirt with a mesh back panel for hot days on the water. Great Lakes Outpost sells the same UPC for $38.50 and HUK.com charges $55, so this is about 58% below the cheapest store we found.
